app.name: FarmSight
app.tagline: When to sell, where to sell, what to grow

signal.disclaimer: This is an estimate, not a guarantee.

direction.DOWN: Our model: the price is likely to fall in the next 4 weeks.

why.liquidityNote: Each past year at this mandi: the harvest-time price vs {{months}} months later. Green bars are years holding paid, red are years it lost.

compare.title: Where to sell: net price after transport

seasonStatus.RANKED: Eligible comparison: {{comparable}} of {{n}} crops have current reference prices, ordered by estimated profit.
seasonStatus.TOO_FEW_CROPS: No comparison: we track too few crops of this season here ({{n}}), so none is ranked.
seasonStatus.NOT_ENOUGH_CURRENT_EVIDENCE: Not enough comparable evidence: only {{comparable}} of {{n}} crops have current, reliable reference prices, so none is put first.

issues.FROZEN_PRICE: AMIS showed the same price for weeks
issues.FEW_YEARS: too few years of price history

policy.title: Wheat support price: policy context
policy.limit: Policy news, not a mandi price, and not a price you are guaranteed to get.
policy.OUTDATED: The latest we have is from {{date}} ({{source}}): {{text}}. It may have changed since.
policy.UNAVAILABLE: No current support-price information. Check with the agriculture department before relying on one.
policy.uncertain: Policy changed in the last {{days}} days: treat the support price as uncertain.

notes.RICE_WATER_BAHAWALPUR: Water check: rice is a summer crop here (sown {{sow}}, harvested {{harvest}}), and canal water in Bahawalpur division has run short before ({{source}}, {{date}}). Before choosing rice, check that your canal turns or tubewell can water it through the season. A consideration, not advice against rice.

history.title: Price history
history.seasonalNote: Each month as a % of the yearly trend (median across years). Above 100 is usually a better month to sell.

margin.title: What you keep from the price

supportStatus.INDICATIVE: indicative price: private aggregators bought, not the government

margin.costNote: Cost of production: Punjab official tables, updated for inflation ({{confidence}}).
